name: KinFlo Convex adapter switch plan

providerBoundary.notes: This plan orders fixture-to-live adapter switching only. It does not change generatedApiAvailable false, import generated Convex API files, execute hosted Convex functions, or touch external providers.

globalPrerequisites: Vambah approves hosted Convex project setup, billing/backup/auth/env ownership, and npm run convex:codegen.
Generated bindings are reviewed against KINFLO_GENERATED_API_BINDINGS.
npm run kinflo:validate-generated-api passes after codegen review.
npm run kinflo:validate-live-smoke and npm run kinflo:dry-run-live-smoke pass immediately before hosted smoke.
Read-only hosted smokes pass before any mutation-backed adapter is switched.
Every switched surface keeps fixture rollback available until smoke evidence is captured and reviewed.

surfaces.fixtureSource: tenant, site, role, and audit tables
surfaces.rollback: Return tenant/site/audit tables to fixtureKinfloShellAdapter if scope filtering or audit visibility fails.

surfaces.fixtureSource: plan cards and tenant entitlement table
surfaces.rollback: Restore fixture plan and entitlement cards if usage math, overrides, or limits diverge.
Keep /kinflo-sites preview routed to local fixtures if published/draft filtering or public-safe data fails.

surfaces.fixtureSource: site launch evidence across admin, content, preview, CRM, domain, integration, campaign, and AI gates
surfaces.rollback: Restore fixture launch readiness if any launch gate is overstated or cross-tenant evidence leaks.

surfaces.fixtureSource: data mode, filters, density, and landing-page defaults
requiredSmokeEvidence: tenant/site scoped preferences require matching access
surfaces.rollback: Return preference controls to local state if tenant/site permission checks or personal defaults fail.

switchBatches.label: Site creation, invitations, and activation readiness

surfaces.fixtureSource: data mode header and launch gates
surfaces.rollback: Keep activation smoke records labeled as smoke data and leave data mode on fixtures if seed output differs from manifest expectations.

surfaces.fixtureSource: launch packets and site creation wizard
surfaces.rollback: Archive the smoke site, revoke pending invites, and return launch packets to fixtures if template creation or owner scope fails.

switchBatches.label: Public lead capture and CRM workflow

surfaces.fixtureSource: lead, pipeline, task, and intake fixtures
requiredSmokeEvidence: pipeline transition appends pipeline, journey, timeline, and audit events
surfaces.rollback: Mark smoke leads and workflow data as test-only, restore fixture CRM tables, and keep outbound notifications paused.

switchBatches.label: Provider readiness metadata without provider writes

surfaces.fixtureSource: site domain rows and launch checklist
surfaces.rollback: Deactivate smoke domain metadata and keep DNS/SSL/Vercel attachment blocked if hostname or entitlement checks fail.

surfaces.fixtureSource: provider settings, env key references, and activation gates
surfaces.rollback: Return integration readiness rows to fixtures and keep provider env activation blocked if settings expose secrets or scope incorrectly.

surfaces.fixtureSource: campaign drafts, review steps, safety gates, and approval state
surfaces.rollback: Pause campaign records, restore fixture campaign review state, and keep email/SMS/automation sends blocked.

surfaces.fixtureSource: AI prompt, source, output, reviewer, and publish-target records
surfaces.rollback: Keep generated output unpublished, return AI review rows to fixtures, and block AI provider calls until provenance smoke passes.

rollbackRequirements: Keep fixtureKinfloShellAdapter available for every switched surface until hosted smoke evidence is reviewed.
Never switch a mutation-backed surface before read-only tenant/site/access/launch smokes pass.
Pause the switch immediately on any cross-tenant read or write leak.
Do not attach DNS, SSL, email, SMS, payment, storage, or AI providers from this plan.
Preserve audit evidence and mark smoke records as test data before cleanup.
completionEvidence: All surface convexFunctions resolve to KINFLO_GENERATED_API_BINDINGS.
All switchAllowed flags remain false in this provider-light phase.
All surfaces declare rollback and requiredSmokeEvidence.
